_comment: Default parameter values for UI scenarios. Loaded by build_*_scenario functions and used as ScenarioParam defaults. Edit here to change starting values in the scenario picker.

2v2._comment_attrs: Per-player attribute overrides. Each key overrides that attribute for the uniform skill drawn from *_skill_min/max. Omit a key to keep the uniform value. Attributes: top_speed, acceleration, stamina, kick_precision, kick_power, dribbling, ball_control, tackling.
